The sinkhole is 138.5 metres (454 ft) deep, which makes it the deepest of its kind (light hole type) in Central Europe. It is a popular tourist attraction for casual visitors to the region, in addition to cavers and advanced technical divers.


== Location ==
Macocha Abyss is located in the Vilémovice municipality in the South Moravian Region, 20 kilometres (12 mi) north of the city of Brno. It is part of the Punkva Caves and the Punkva River flows through it.


== Description ==

The abyss is 174 metres (571 ft) long and 76 metres (249 ft) wide. It is 138.5 metres (454 ft) deep to the surface of Dolní Lake. Below the surface of Dolní Lake are other underground spaces, so far explored to a total depth of 187.5 metres (615 ft). The dimensions of the abyss allow for its overall daylight and therefore it is classified in the "light hole" abyss category.
